text:
Priya S: morning folks, excited to join today! quick questions around security onboarding: 1) my security orientation conflicts with an onboarding walkthrough  can i shift it? 2) my company mac prompts that FileVault is paused, is there a supported troubleshoot flow? 3) do i need to request KMS or is sandbox access pre-provisioned for new eng hires? thanks!

Jon H: welcome Priya! :tada: you can reschedule orientation in the training portal (https://redwood.internal/training) or reply here with two times that work. for FileVault first try: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault and see if "Turn On" is shown. if it shows "Paused" that's usually an MDM sync issue. don't enable manually if it's company-managed.

IT Bot: Ticket created: IT-50731 for device MDM sync (owner: Jon H). ETA 30-120 minutes.

Lena M: hi Priya, congrats! for serials, send the last 4 of the device serial or About This Mac screenshot. we'll push the profile. if FileVault is Paused please run: `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and share the output; we may re-push the FileVault profile. if you're uncomfortable running commands, i can do it from MDM.

Priya S: thanks! last 4 are A3B7. i ran `profiles status` and it says: "MDM: enrolled, FileVault: paused"

Jon H: noted A3B7, re-pushing FileVault profile now. also rescheduled your orientation to tomorrow 11-12 per portal availability.

Security Bot: Reminder: phishing simulation will send a benign test email this week from "security-sim@redwood.test". reporting it via the Report Phish button completes your simulation requirement. repeated failures trigger a brief follow-up training email.

Lena M: Priya, pushed profile to device A3B7. filevault should unpause and begin encryption within ~20-40 minutes. i'll update ticket when encryption completes.

IT Bot: IT-50731 updated: FileVault profile push initiated by Lena M.

Priya S: awesome, thanks all. one quick KMS question: i'm building a demo against the dev cluster, is there a lightweight path to creds?

Jon H: for demos we usually provide time-limited service tokens. open the KMS access request form (https://redwood.internal/sec/kms-request) and mark it "demo/demo". tag your manager for approval and security will issue short-lived creds. full KMS roles are granted only after justification and manager sign-off.

Priya S: perfect, i'll file the request. appreciate the quick help :pray:
